stem: Voltmarkt's CFO asks: "Gross margin is €200,000 lower than last quarter. How much of that is because we sold more cheap accessories and fewer TVs, and how much because suppliers charged us more?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × (net revenue - cost of goods) / net revenue, for each quarter
The margin change split into price, cost, volume and mix effects
Net revenue / units sold, for each quarter
100 × pocket value / list value, for each quarter
